name: Pizzeria Bianco
headsUp: I couldn't be more biased about a pizzeria, so feel free to check other reviews (which will 100% agree with me)
teaser: All the bold and rustic flavors Chris Bianco perfected in Phoenix, filtered through talented chefs and cooks who absolutely kill it on market pies, sides, and special pastas, as well.
address: 1320 E 7th St Suite 100, Los Angeles, CA 90021, USA
review: All the bold and rustic flavors Chris Bianco perfected in Phoenix, filtered through talented chefs and cooks who absolutely kill it on market pies, sides, and special pastas, as well. The LA location may lose house-made mozzarella, but you get the bounty of produce from the Santa Monica farmer's market, so the special pies really are special.
